entities.name: Jaroslav Svejkovský
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jaroslav "Yogi" Svejkovský is a Czech ice hockey coach and former professional left wing. He currently serves as an assistant coach of the Philadelphia Flyers. He was drafted in the first round, 17th overall, by the Washington Capitals in the 1996 NHL Entry Draft, and played for them and the Tampa Bay Lightning.
